roles.name: User Access administrator
roles.description: Perform most delegated access operations for users and service accounts. This includes managing standard groups and assigning/revoking non-admin roles. Cannot invite new users, assign the Org Admin role or manage any group that contains the User Access Administrator role (to prevent privilege escalation).

roles.name: User Access principal viewer
roles.description: Perform read operations as a non-Organization Administrator on principals within user access.

roles.name: Workspace viewer
roles.description: Grants read-only access to workspace pages (lists, hierarchy, names, descriptions), but can't perform actions related to granting access or asset management.

roles.name: Workspace administrator
roles.description: Grants full access to workspaces. Users can create, modify and delete workspaces, and grant access to workspaces and configure user groups and roles. Users are granted this role for workspaces they create, or are given access to.
